The '''undead rancor''' was a large [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] mutated by the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The creature was the result of an ill-fated experiment conducted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] of the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident took place in the Imperial Research Facility and the Blackwing virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment. The virus killed most of the people in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|area]], turning them into [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. At that time, the undead rancor lived in the caves below the Imperial Research and Prison Facility. The creature was eventually defeated by a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who explored the Research Facility during the epidemic on Dathomir. In the Rancor's caves, the spacer discovered several [[Blackwing Crystal|Blackwing crystals]],<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> which could be used to produce a smoke-colored [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade.<ref name="SWG:BC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Blackwing Crystal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The undead rancor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The undead rancor was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
